name: ASUS TUF Gaming VG249Q5R 23.8 Inch FHD Fast IPS 200Hz Gaming Monitor
shortDescription: ASUS TUF Gaming VG249Q5R 23.8 Inch Full HD Fast IPS Gaming Monitor (1920x1080 Resolution / 200Hz Refresh Rate / 1ms GTG 0.3ms Min Response Time / HDR10 Support / 100% sRGB Color / Adaptive-Sync VRM / Extreme Low Motion B
descriptionHtml:
ASUS TUF Gaming VG249Q5R 23.8 Inch Full HD Fast IPS Gaming Monitor (1920x1080 Resolution / 200Hz Refresh Rate / 1ms GTG 0.3ms Min Response Time / HDR10 Support / 100% sRGB Color / Adaptive-Sync VRM / Extreme Low Motion Blur / AI Visual Assistant / Built-in 2W Speakers / DisplayPort 1.4 & HDMI 2.0 / Official 1-Year Local Agent Warranty)

Experience fluid high-framerate gameplay with the ASUS TUF Gaming VG249Q5R Gaming Monitor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by an official 1-Year agent warranty. Featuring a 23.8-inch Full HD (1920x1080) Fast IPS display with wide 178-degree viewing angles, this monitor delivers an ultra-smooth 200Hz refresh rate alongside an impressive 0.3ms minimum response time. Equipped with Adaptive-Sync VRM technology, Extreme Low Motion Blur (ELMB), AI Visual Assistant technology, HDR10 compliance, 100% sRGB color spectrum coverage, integrated stereo speakers, and low blue light hardware safeguards.
